description: This PHP class 'Pickup' extends the core Model class in the Opencart framework, providing functionality to generate shipping quotes for a 'Pickup' shipping method. It handles loading language and geo zone models, checks geo zone applicability based on configuration and address, and returns shipping method data accordingly.

classes.name: Pickup
classes.description: Represents the Pickup shipping method, providing quote calculation based on geo zone and configuration.

methods.name: getQuote
methods.description: Calculates and returns shipping quote data for the Pickup method based on the address provided.
